topics.title: Write about moments you felt you lived on the edge.
guiding_questions: What happened?
Where and when did it happen?
Who was with you?
How did you feel during the moment?
What did you learn from it?
topics.sample_essay: Last summer, I climbed a high mountain with my brother. It was very steep. We had no safety rope. My heart was beating fast. I felt afraid but excited too. The view from the top was incredible. I learned that we must always be careful with our lives. Safety comes first for everyone in life.

topics.title: Write about something happy you passed by.
guiding_questions: What was the happy event?
Where and when did it happen?
Who was with you?
How did you feel?
Why was it special to you?
topics.sample_essay: Last year, I passed by a small park. I saw a little boy helping an old man. He helped him cross the street. The old man smiled and said thank you. I felt so happy inside. It was a small but beautiful thing. This moment made my day so great and lovely for me today.

topics.title: Write about something sad happened to you.
guiding_questions: What sad thing happened?
Where and when did it happen?
Who was with you?
How did you feel?
What did you learn from it?
topics.sample_essay: Last winter, my cat got very sick. I took him to the doctor. But he could not help him. My cat died at night. I cried a lot. I felt very sad for many days. My father hugged me and said it was life. I learned that we must love our family every day now.

topics.title: Write about why some people like to try adventures.
guiding_questions: Why do some people like adventures?
What do they gain from adventures?
What risks are involved?
Do you like adventures? Why?
Is it good or bad to try adventures?
topics.sample_essay: Some people love adventures. They want to feel free and strong. They also want to see new places. In addition to fun, they gain good memories. However, adventures have risks. People may get hurt or lose their lives. Therefore, they must be careful. Safety is very important for everyone in life and health too indeed.
